name: Q5
summary:
Q5 is RobotEra’s wheeled humanoid platform for interactive service and research. The manufacturer’s CES 2026 announcement specifies 44 degrees of freedom and describes coordinated movements such as lowering the body to pick up objects.

RobotEra demonstrated visitor interaction and gift delivery at CES. Its wheeled design is intended for indoor commercial service environments as well as research. These demonstrations establish the model and intended use; they do not by themselves verify unattended service reliability or quantify autonomy.
